definitions.explanation: The basic materials or substances used to manufacture or produce something. Commonly seen on food labels listing ingredients and in manufacturing contexts.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{価格|かかく}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The price of raw materials has gone up.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}の{原材料|げんざいりょう}{表示|ひょうじ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the ingredients list on the food product.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{高騰|こうとう}により、{製品|せいひん}の{値上|ねあ}げが{避|さ}けられない。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, price increases on products are unavoidable.

notes: Composed of {原|げん} (original, raw) + {材料|ざいりょう} (material, ingredient). Very commonly seen on Japanese food packaging under {原材料|げんざいりょう}{名|めい} (ingredient name), where all ingredients must be listed by law. Also used in manufacturing and economics: {原材料|げんざいりょう}{費|ひ} (raw material costs), {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{調達|ちょうたつ} (procurement of raw materials).
